hero.heading: Brisbane video production by the team behind 3,000+ videos.
hero.sub: One-off shoots and monthly content retainers for brands, businesses and real estate agents. Shot, edited, delivered. No fluff in between.

services.heading: Two ways to work with us.

cards.title: One-off shoots
cards.body: A launch, an event, a brand video, a property. One brief, one shoot day, edits delivered inside a week.
items: 4K video and drone where it earns its place
Edited deliverables cut for where they'll live

cards.title: Monthly content retainers
cards.body: Consistent content without hiring an in-house team. We plan it, shoot it, edit it and hand it back ready to post.
items: Monthly shoot day at your place or on location
Batch of edited reels and cutdowns every month
Content planning and shot lists handled

agentBanner.heading: Real estate agent? Read this first.
agentBanner.body: We'll happily shoot your content. But content alone gets you seen, the full Digital Door Knock system gets you listings: strategy, social management, paid ads and your suburb locked so no competitor can use us. If you're an agent, that's the better conversation to have.

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.body: Quick enquiry, then a short call. We scope the shoot, lock the date and quote you a fixed price. No surprises later.

steps.title: Shoot day
steps.body: We turn up with a plan and a shot list, not just a camera. You'll know exactly what we're capturing and why before we roll.

steps.title: Delivered, ready to post
steps.body: Edited deliverables inside 7 days, cut for the platforms they'll actually live on. One round of revisions included.

founder.heading: Six years. 3,000+ videos. One standard.
founder.body: DD. Video is the production arm of The Digital Door Knock, run by founder Blake Habib. Six years of production across real estate, brands and businesses, 3,000+ videos delivered, and work featured on national news. We're not a videographer with a website. We're a content machine with a shoot calendar.
founder.name: Blake Habib

items.a: Standard is 7 days from shoot to delivery. Retainer clients get priority. If you've got a hard deadline, tell us up front and we'll tell you straight if we can hit it.
Yes. Gold Coast and Sunshine Coast regularly, and further for the right project. Travel is quoted up front, never added after.
You own the edited deliverables outright. Raw footage is available, just ask when we quote.

items.q: Can you handle the posting too?
items.a: For real estate agents, yes, that's the full Digital Door Knock system. For brands and businesses we deliver post-ready content and can advise on rollout.
Every job is quoted fixed before we book a date. Tell us what you need and we'll come back with a number, usually same day.

quote.heading: Got a project? Let's price it.
quote.sub: Tell us what you're after and we'll come back with a fixed quote and the next available shoot dates. Usually same day.
